# `pmem` tools

5 tools in the `pmem` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client receives that docstring's prose as the tool's description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_create_persistent_memory_volume` | `mutate` | `pmem.create_volume` | `lpar` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create a DRAM persistent-memory volume assigned to an inactive partition. |
| `hmc_delete_persistent_memory_volume` | `destructive` | `pmem.delete_volume` | `lpar` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Delete a persistent-memory volume; the data it holds is destroyed. |
| `hmc_get_persistent_memory_volume` | `read` | `pmem.get_volume` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Read one virtual persistent-memory volume by UUID or exact name. |
| `hmc_list_persistent_memory_volumes` | `read` | `pmem.list_volumes` | `managed_system` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | List a managed system's virtual persistent-memory volumes. |
| `hmc_rename_persistent_memory_volume` | `mutate` | `pmem.rename_volume` | `lpar` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Rename a persistent-memory volume assigned to the named partition. |
